name: B1E unit
description: The B1E unit was a model of medical droid. A B1E droid served aboard the Corporate Sector Authority Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser Resolute and in 19 ABY, the unit treated the Pantoran spacer Reen Irana for injuries that she had received after being shot in the chest with a stun blast by the Jedi archivist Mander Zuma.
